cases.title: Schema is at alembic 0014_crm_kpis: committed columns on forecast_snapshots and the user_activity_days table
Owner gets all six KPIs in BRD order with value, numerator, denominator, target, period, note and definition
Only the duplicate rate has a BRD target (< 1%)
Agents and level-2 managers get the workspace KPIs (duplicate rate, adoption) as unavailable
The Sales Head (level 1) sees the workspace KPIs
Bad filters: quarter without fy 400, fy out of range 422, member outside your team 404, no token 401
Duplicate contact rate: numerator / denominator match the BRD rules applied to the rows from SQL
The dataset's duplicates: similar name at the same company, Gmail dots/+tag, same phone (6 of 8 live; deleted one ignored)
The contacts counted are exactly those the Duplicates page groups
member= narrows the duplicate rate to that person's contacts (their duplicate partner is someone else's)
Merging a duplicate group resolves it: 4 of 7
Leads from a reply (one-click, source 'Campaign reply'), by hand after a reply, and unrelated leads are created
Reply-to-lead: leads from replies / contacts with a positive reply match SQL (3 / 4 = 75%)
An agent's reply-to-lead covers their own leads and contacts (2 / 3)
No positive replies: value null with a note (the stack runs without an AI classifier key)
Lead-to-SQL: SQLs among the period's new leads / new leads match SQL (3 / 7)
SQL-to-win: won SQLs / SQLs match SQL and the SQL-to-win report (2 / 3)
Lead-to-SQL equals the Leads & SQLs report's rate
Forecast accuracy for the last finished quarter = won in it / committed at its start, from SQL (3000 / 4000 = 75%)
Forecast accuracy can exceed 100% (rep 1: 1200 won / 1000 committed = 120%)
The forecast-accuracy report uses the same BRD formula (accuracy = actual / committed) and keeps the weighted measure as secondary
A snapshot stores committed = won to date + open Commit deals (stage default or set by hand; Omitted excluded)
The current quarter by fy/quarter is in progress: won so far / committed, with a note
A quarter with nothing committed in scope gives null with a note
Hidden amounts: an agent sees the accuracy % but not revenue or committed amounts
Adoption this week = users active this week / licensed seats, from SQL (5 / 5; the deactivated user is no seat)
Adoption trend: 9 weeks, last week 2 / 5 = 40% (deactivated user ignored), Sunday counted in its own week
member= narrows adoption to that team's seats (manager + rep 1)
Signing in and using the API records one activity row per user per day
Another workspace sees only its own numbers (1 seat, no contacts, no leads)
Another workspace cannot report on this workspace's people (404)
The KPI call answers quickly (< 3 s)
